bioParagraphs: I bridge the gap between speculative design and rock-solid production code. Over the last 8 years, I have architected web systems and sensory interfaces for venture-backed startups, research labs, and frontier AI companies.
My work is rooted in buttery 60fps micro-interactions, mathematically rigorous typography, kinetic layout engines, and zero-compromise developer ergonomics.
When I step away from the IDE, you will find me experimenting with modular analog synths, contributing to open-source shaders, and analyzing brutalist architecture.

projects.title: LMS TASCE

projects.overview: LMS TASCE modernizes tertiary education delivery by providing students and lecturers with a centralized, high-availability platform for digital coursework, virtual submissions, and examination management.
projects.challenge: Handling peak concurrent login traffic during examination windows and assignment deadlines without server degradation.
projects.solution: Architected optimized database queries with session clustering and edge caching, resulting in seamless response times even during peak academic cycles.

Reduced manual grading turnaround time by 65%
Maintained 99.9% uptime during nationwide semester examinations

faq.q: What is your typical project engagement structure?
faq.a: I work on both fixed-scope architectural builds (2-8 weeks for high-impact MVPs/microsites) and embedded staff-level engineering retainers for select tech teams.

faq.q: Can you handle both UI design and full-stack code?
faq.a: Yes! I pride myself on bridging design engineering and production architecture. I frequently take projects from blank Figma canvas through database schema, API design, animations, and zero-downtime deployment.

faq.q: What timezone do you operate in?
faq.a: Based in Pacific Time (San Francisco, UTC-7/8), with flexible collaboration hours accommodating teams across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

faq.q: How can we kick off a collaboration?
faq.a: Use the contact page form or email me directly at aura.vance.dev@gmail.com with a brief summary of your timeline and goals. I usually reply within 24 hours.
